title: Caliph al-Maamun and the Strange Scholar
logline: A poor stranger sits by the door of the caliphs assembly, answers three questions nobody else can, is moved seat by seat to the caliphs side, and then refuses the caliphs wine because his mind is the only thing that brought him there.
moral: Knowledge and a clear mind raise a person, not clothes or money; guard the thing that earned your place.
tone: Warm court comedy of manners: quiet, dignified hero, gently mocked snobs, one held moment of suspense at the cup, a generous ending. No villain and no humiliation.

beats.summary: The caliph who loves learning gathers his scholars.
A stranger in patched clothes enters and sits by the door, far from everyone.
The scholars ignore him: poor clothes must mean little learning.
The caliphs question defeats the scholars.
The stranger quietly raises his hand and asks to speak.
His answer is exact and plain; the knot comes undone.
First move: closer to the scholars.
Second question: he joins the quarrelling views into one clear meaning.
Second move; those who ignored him now watch him.
Third answer, wider than anyone expected: he is seated beside the caliph.
At the meal the forgotten stranger is the guest of honour.
The caliph offers him a cup of wine.
He politely refuses; the caliph asks why.
Not my clothes or money but my mind and knowledge brought me near you.
To drink would spoil the very thing that raised him.
The delighted caliph orders a hundred thousand silver pieces.
He leaves honoured through the door he entered unnoticed.

scenes.composition: The goblet travels on the centre line between the two faces; it ends at (545, 770), exactly between them, and stays there through S12 and S13 as the object of the scene.

actions.action: Lifts the food trays away (two trips shown as one: trays slide off left).
actions.acting: quick, eyes down

actions.action: Returns with a round tray of four goblets and a tall jug and kneels to set it on the cloth.
actions.acting: careful balance: tip 0.03 sway, gaze on the goblets

actions.action: Proud and eager each take a goblet; the elder waves his away and keeps his bread.
actions.acting: proud: lid 0.4, pleased; eager copies him a beat late

actions.action: Picks up the jug and pours red wine into a goblet (a short red stream, the level rises).
actions.acting: eyes on the cup, smile; anticipation lift of the jug
actions.library: handLW jug, goblet {fill: 0 to 1}; stream as a tapered red shape

actions.action: Turns and holds the full goblet out to the stranger at arms length.
actions.acting: gaze on the stranger, brow -0.5, generous smile; arm settles with 8 % overshoot, wine surface tilts and levels

actions.action: Close on the goblet: yellow cup, red wine with a white highlight, one glint star.
actions.acting: the strangers eyes drop from the caliphs face to the cup and stay there

actions.action: Does not move his hands. His smile fades to a closed, thoughtful mouth.
actions.acting: suspense by stillness: only the pupils move, cup to caliph to cup; blink suppressed

actions.action: Cut-away: proud and eager clink goblets and sip.
actions.acting: eyes closing as they drink (lid 0.8), heads tip back slightly out of sync

actions.action: Back in the two-shot he nudges the cup 15 units closer: go on.
actions.acting: brow -0.6, small encouraging nod

scenes.summary: He declines: a hand on his chest, a small bow, an open palm. The cup stays in the caliphs hand. The scholars freeze mid-sip. The caliph, astonished, asks why.

camera.notes: Two-shot held (x 550, y 730, zoom 2.2); at 122.4 widen slightly (zoom 1.8) to bring the frozen scholars heads into the frame edges; back to 2.2 on the question at 124.5.

scenes.composition: Cup at centre; the strangers refusing palm stops 40 units short of it, never touching. The WHY balloon sits above the caliph on the right, clear of both faces.

actions.action: Places his right hand flat on his chest and bows his head.
actions.acting: head drop 10 over 0.4 s, lid 0.6 during the bow, brow -0.4: grateful, not stern

actions.action: Looks up with a gentle smile and speaks a few soft words.
actions.acting: gaze on the caliphs eyes (not the cup), talk 0.4

actions.action: His left hand rises, open palm toward the cup, and stops short of it.
actions.acting: slow ease, no push; fingers relaxed; body does not lean away
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.shield one hand, handLW keyed to (505, 775)

actions.action: The cup hangs in the air between them, unclaimed; the wine surface settles flat.
actions.acting: caliphs smile freezes; his arm stays out

actions.action: Eyebrows shoot up; he pulls the cup back a little and looks from the cup to the man.
actions.acting: brow -0.9, mouth 'o', sq 1.04 pop with settle; gaze cup, stranger, cup (2-frame snaps)

actions.action: In the widened frame: proud frozen with his goblet at his lips, eyes wide over the rim; eager lowers his cup guiltily; elder smiles into his beard.
actions.acting: held shock, blinks suppressed on proud; eager gaze darts caliph to stranger

actions.action: Sets the cup down on the cloth between them and asks, palm up.
actions.acting: lean in (tip 0.06), talk 0.7, brow -0.5: curious, not angry
actions.library: handRW down to (545, 895), PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp one hand

actions.action: A small speech balloon over the caliph.
actions.acting: the stranger takes a breath before answering (sq 1.03)

scenes.summary: The answer. He touches his patched sleeve: not this. He turns out an empty purse: not this. Then he touches his temple and a small glowing book and lamp rise beside his head: this.

camera.notes: Medium close on the stranger with the listening caliphs shoulder and face at the right edge of frame (x 500, y 720, zoom 2.4); slow push to 2.7 by 137.2. Keep it one held shot so the three gestures read as a list.

scenes.composition: Two crossed-out icons appear at the left of his head (x 380, y 600 and y 680 in world), the kept icons at the right (x 600, y 590), so the eye moves from rejected to chosen. Nothing covers his face.

actions.action: Straightens his back and turns fully to the caliph.
actions.acting: calm, gaze on the caliph, brow 0; one blink before speaking

actions.action: Hand on chest, a short respectful bow as he addresses him.
actions.acting: head drop 6, talk 0.6

actions.action: His hand draws a short line from the door side toward the caliph: the journey he made across the room.
actions.acting: gaze follows his hand, then back to the caliph
actions.library: handRW keyed sweep; a dashed arc with three seat dots (A, B, C) and a star at the end

actions.action: Pinches his own patched sleeve and holds it up; a small robe icon pops at the left and a red cross strikes it.
actions.acting: small shake of the head, wry half smile
actions.library: handLW to the right sleeve; S.emphasis cross with overshoot

actions.action: Shows an empty open palm, then turns a small limp purse upside down: nothing falls. A coin icon pops under the robe icon and is crossed out.
actions.acting: brow -0.5, gaze at the purse then the caliph; the caliph chuckles (sq pulse)
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp; purse (planned prop) rotated 180 degrees; S.emphasis cross

actions.action: Raises one finger to his temple and taps it once on the word.
actions.acting: anticipation: hand rises during the word before; eyes bright (wide lid 0), small smile
actions.library: handRW to the temple (local about [30, -205], measure), dip on the tap

actions.action: A small lit lamp icon with short yellow rays pops beside his head on the right.
actions.acting: the caliphs eyes go to it

actions.action: An open book icon pops under the lamp (pages full of lines this time, the opposite of the blank book in S3); both get a green tick.
actions.acting: the stranger lowers his hand to his lap; holds the caliphs eye
actions.library: book shape with line strokes; tick flash 2 frames

actions.action: Nods slowly, his hand stroking his beard.
actions.acting: lid 0.3, thoughtful smile; gaze stays on the stranger

scenes.summary: If I drank it: a thought cloud shows the lamp in his head going out and his clean straight answer line curling back into a knot, while the imagined him slides back down the hall to the door. He waves the cloud away: that is what raised me here today.

camera.notes: From the close (zoom 2.4) pull out to a medium two-shot with headroom for the cloud (x 520, y 600, zoom 1.5) by 139.6; hold; at 143.9 ease down to the pair and the cup (x 540, y 740, zoom 1.9).

scenes.composition: Thought cloud in the top band (centre x 520, y 380, 520 x 300), trail to the stranger (tail [500, 640]). The cup on the cloth is visible at the bottom of the frame throughout.

actions.action: Points down at the cup on the cloth, then up beside his head as the cloud trail bubbles appear.
actions.acting: gaze cup then up; brow 0.2, serious
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.pointDown then pointUp; thoughtCloud(ctx, 520, 380, 520, 300, t, {tail:[500, 640], scale:0.45})

actions.action: Cloud opens: a small copy of himself on the honour cushion beside the throne lifts a goblet and drinks.
actions.acting: imagined self: lid 0.8, tip -0.05; the real stranger watches it gravely
actions.library: thoughtCloud inside: person {costume:'ascetic', sit:1} at 0.45, goblet

actions.action: Above the imagined self the lamp icon flickers and goes out with a wisp of smoke.
actions.acting: the caliph looks up at the cloud, mouth o
actions.library: lamp icon alpha keyed 1 to 0, wisp as a wavy line

actions.action: The straight answer line from S5 curls back into the knot; the imagined self sways with his turban slipped over one eye.
actions.acting: imagined self: tip sway 0.1 at 2 Hz, mouth o, lid 0.6; kept mild and comic, not ugly
actions.library: answerBalloon {icon:'knot', untie: 1 to 0} inside the cloud; swing()

actions.action: The imagined self slides backward off the dais and across the floor to the bare spot by the door (seat A); the cushion stays empty.
actions.acting: accelerating slide with a small bump at the dais edge; real stranger shakes his head once
actions.library: kfn ease-in on x, fallY for the 40-unit step, impactSquash

actions.action: Sweeps the cloud away with the back of his hand (it pops), then lays his palm on the cushion he sits on.
actions.acting: firm brow 0.3 then soft; gaze returns to the caliph
actions.library: cloud p keyed to 0 with a pop; handLW to the cushion

actions.action: Open hand toward the caliph and the hall: your assembly.
actions.acting: small bow of the head; talk 0.6

actions.action: Folds his hands in his lap and is silent. The cup stands untouched between them.
actions.acting: steady gaze, slow blink, breathe(); the scholars behind lower their own goblets to the cloth one by one

scenes.summary: The caliph is more pleased by this than by all three answers. He pushes the cup aside, claps for the treasurer, and a chest of silver is set before the scholar while a counter races to 100,000.

camera.notes: Two-shot (x 550, y 730, zoom 2.0) for the delight; at 152.5 a quick top-band flash of the three ticked balloons; at 154.6 pull out to the wide (x 480, y 690, zoom 1.25) for the chest entering from the door.

scenes.composition: Chest lands at x 380 on the floor in front of the cloth, left of the stranger; counter in the top band at centre (x 500, y 330). The three small ticked balloons (line, disc, wide) appear in a row at y 420 with a larger fourth balloon (lamp icon) above them for this answer.

actions.action: Throws his head back and laughs with delight, both hands slapping his knees.
actions.acting: mouth 'open' smile, lid 0.7, sq pulse 1.06, tip -0.05; follow-through: his crown jewel bobs a beat late

actions.action: Picks the goblet up from between them and sets it far away to his own side, out of the picture.
actions.acting: decisive, gaze on the stranger not the cup
actions.library: handRW keyed, goblet slides out of frame

actions.action: Clasps the strangers shoulder.
actions.acting: warm gaze, brow -0.5; the stranger smiles, modest (lid 0.3)

actions.action: Three small ticked balloons pop in a row in the top band (straight line, whole disc, wide book), then a fourth, larger, with the lamp icon, pops above them all.
actions.acting: each 0.2 s apart; the fourth with a bigger overshoot; both men glance up
actions.library: answerBalloon x3 at 0.5 scale, then {icon:'lamp'} at 0.8; stagger

actions.action: Claps twice and points to the door.
actions.acting: clap on 155.0 and 155.35; commanding but smiling

actions.action: The servant comes in from the door bent under a heavy chest and sets it down at x 380.
actions.acting: short heavy steps, tip 0.1; impact squash of the chest and a dust puff on landing at 156.6

actions.action: The counter runs up fast and locks on 100,000 with a pop.
actions.acting: scholars lean toward the chest, eyes wide, staggered
actions.library: S.counter keyed 0 to 100000 by 157.9, settleTo on lock

actions.action: The lid swings open: a mound of white silver coins with blue shading, two glints; one coin rolls out and spins flat.
actions.acting: the stranger looks at the chest, then at the caliph, and puts his hand on his chest in thanks
actions.library: treasureHoard chest {open: 0 to 1}, coinPile {metal:'silver'}; swing() for the coin wobble

scenes.summary: He leaves by the same door he came in through, now with the whole hall on its feet: the scholars bow as he passes, the servant carries the chest behind him. In the doorway he turns, touches his temple and bows. The untouched cup is left in the foreground. THE END.

camera.notes: Wide hall (x 470, y 690, zoom 1.25); slow pull-out to the full hall (x 500, y 640, zoom 1.0) as he walks left to the door; at 167.3 a gentle push to the doorway (x 300, y 700, zoom 1.4); hold from 169.4 for THE END.

scenes.composition: Mirror of S2: same door, same daylight (now warm dusk), but every eye line points at him. Foreground bottom right: the full goblet alone on the cloth (x 700, y 930), slightly larger than life. THE END lettering in the top band, clear of his head.

actions.action: Rises, bows to the caliph, and walks left toward the door.
actions.acting: upright, unhurried; gaze on the caliph for the bow, then ahead

actions.action: The three scholars stand up as he approaches, one after another.
actions.acting: eager first and fast, elder pushes up on his knees, proud last but lowest bow

actions.action: Each bows as he passes; he answers each with a nod.
actions.acting: tip 0.15 bows in order of his passing; the proud ones eyes stay down a beat longer

actions.action: Follows two steps behind carrying the chest.
actions.acting: tip 0.08 under the weight, eyes on his back
actions.library: walk() on a delayed copy of his path

actions.action: Stands on the dais and raises one hand in farewell.
actions.acting: smile, brow -0.4, gaze following him to the door

actions.action: Above the honour cushion beside the throne the open book icon glows for a second: knowledge won the seat.
actions.acting: the stranger glances back at the cushion while walking
actions.library: book icon, goldGlow 0.4, alpha in and out

actions.action: Reaches the doorway (x 145), stops and turns to face the hall.
actions.acting: last footfall, settle; gaze across the hall to the caliph

actions.action: Touches his temple once (the same tap as in S13) and the small lamp icon pops beside his head.
actions.acting: small smile, bright eyes; payoff of the earlier pose
actions.library: handRW to the temple; S.emphasis lamp

actions.action: In the foreground the full goblet gets a single quiet glint, still untouched.
actions.acting: the caliph looks down at it, then back up at the man, and nods

actions.action: A last bow, then he steps out into the light; the servant with the chest follows.
actions.acting: bow tip 0.12, turn, two steps; figure fades into the bright doorway (alpha to 0.6)
actions.library: walk(); palaceHall behind(ctx) for the figures outside

actions.action: THE END pops in the top band and holds to the last frame; the hall settles: lamps flicker, scholars sit back down, caliph smiling at the door.
actions.acting: idle breathe() and blinks only

ending.description: After the last word (169.34) the scholar has stepped out into the lit doorway. The hall holds: caliph standing on the dais smiling at the door, scholars settling, the full goblet untouched in the right foreground with one glint. THE END pops at 169.8 in the top band and holds to 172.47 (3.0 s after the audio ends). One quiet chime at 170.2.

subtitles.ar: كان الخليفة المأمون يحب العلم،|ويجمع العلماء في مجلسه مرتين كل أسبوع ليتناقشوا في المسائل الصعبة.|وفي أحد المجالس دخل رجل غريب تبدو عليه علامات الفقر،|وجلس بعيدًا عن الجميع.
subtitles.en: Caliph al-Maamun loved learning|and assembled scholars twice a week.|One day an unknown man in poor clothing entered|and sat far from the others.

subtitles.ar: لم يلتفت إليه أكثر الحاضرين،|فقد ظنوا أن ثيابه البسيطة تدل على قلة علمه.|بدأ النقاش، وطرح الخليفة سؤالًا|عجز بعض العلماء عن الإجابة عنه إجابة واضحة ومقنعة.
subtitles.en: Few noticed him,|assuming his simple clothing meant little education.|The debate began, and the caliph posed a question|that several scholars could not answer clearly.

subtitles.ar: رفع الغريب يده بهدوء، واستأذن في الكلام.|ثم قدم جوابًا دقيقًا، وشرح أسبابه بألفاظ سهلة.|أعجب المأمون بفهمه،|ودعاه إلى الجلوس في مكان أقرب إلى العلماء.
subtitles.en: The stranger asked permission to speak.|His precise, plainly explained answer|impressed al-Maamun,|who invited him to sit nearer the scholars.

subtitles.ar: جاء سؤال ثان، فاختلف الحاضرون في تفسيره.|تكلم الرجل مرة أخرى، وجمع بين الأدلة حتى اتضح المعنى.|أشار الخليفة إليه أن يتقدم،|وأصبح موضع اهتمام من كانوا يتجاهلونه.
subtitles.en: A second question divided the gathering.|The stranger weighed the evidence and clarified the answer.|The caliph moved him closer still,|and those who ignored him took notice.

subtitles.ar: وفي السؤال الثالث أظهر الغريب علمًا أوسع مما توقعه الجميع،|فدعاه المأمون للجلوس إلى جانبه.|عند انتهاء المناظرة، جلسوا إلى الطعام،|وصار الرجل ضيفًا مكرمًا بدل الغريب المنسي.
subtitles.en: His third answer surpassed expectations.|Al-Maamun invited him beside him.|After the debate, the company ate together,|and the forgotten stranger became an honored guest.

subtitles.ar: ثم انتقل المجلس إلى الشراب،|وعرض الخليفة على ضيفه كأسًا من الخمر كما كان يفعل مع بعض جلسائه.|اعتذر الرجل بأدب، ولم يتناول الكأس،|فتعجب المأمون وسأله عن السبب.
subtitles.en: The gathering then turned to drinking.|The caliph offered his guest a cup of wine.|The man politely refused,|and al-Maamun asked him why.

subtitles.ar: أجاب العالم: يا أمير المؤمنين،|لم تقربني منك ثيابي ولا مالي، بل عقلي وعلمي.|فإذا شربت ما يذهب عقلي،|فقد أفسدت الشيء الذي رفعني في مجلسك هذا اليوم.
subtitles.en: The scholar replied:|It was neither wealth nor clothing that brought me near you, but my mind and knowledge.|Why drink something|that could take away what earned your respect?

subtitles.ar: سر الخليفة بجوابه أكثر من سروره بأجوبته العلمية،|وأمر له بمئة ألف قطعة من الفضة.|خرج الرجل مكرمًا،|بعدما حفظ بعلمه مكانته، ثم حفظ بعقله سبب تلك المكانة.
subtitles.en: The caliph admired this answer even more|and awarded him one hundred thousand silver coins.|The scholar departed honored,|having protected the very reason for his rise.

new_assets.name: answerBalloon
new_assets.description: Speech balloon with icon content and a badge. answerBalloon(ctx, x, y, w, h, t, {p (pop 0..1), tail:[x, y], icon:'knot'|'wedge'|'pieces'|'whole'|'wide'|'lamp'|'dots', tangle (1..2 extra loops), untie 0..1 (knot to straight line), col, grow 0..1 (wide: 220x160 to 820x330, icons book, star, crescent, compass pop at grow 0.2, 0.45, 0.7, 0.9), mark:'?'|'tick'|null}). Default size 380 x 240; small 150 x 110.
new_assets.implementation: Balloon outline: reuse the Halftone Pop speech shape or thoughtCloud's body with a pointed tail (shape() with white fill, lw 6). Knot: one polyline through seeded loop points (K.rng seed fixed), drawn with the brush stroke; untie lerps every point onto a horizontal segment, so it is a pure function of the untie value. Wedges: three 120 degree pie slices (red, yellow, blue) of a disc r 60; 'pieces' draws their dashed outlines apart, 'whole' draws them joined. Badge: Bangers '?' in red or a two-stroke green tick in a white disc r 26 at the top right. Pop with settleTo overshoot.

new_assets.name: goblet
new_assets.description: Stemmed drinking cup 44 x 64 with fill 0..1, slosh (surface tilt, radians), glint; matching jug 60 x 110 with a spout and handle. Any feast, tavern or poison story.
new_assets.implementation: shape() bowl (trapezoid with rounded base), stem rect and foot ellipse in yellow with black lw 5 and red Ben-Day shadow on the left third; wine as a clipped red polygon whose top edge rotates by slosh; white highlight stroke; star glint from S.emphasis.

new_assets.name: floorCushion
new_assets.description: Loose floor cushion: floorCushion(ctx, x, y, {w: 100, h: 30, col, dot}) drawn exactly like the palaceHall dais cushion so that seats can be placed, carried and handed over.
new_assets.implementation: Lift the four-point shape() call used for A.cushions in sets/towns.js into its own function (same seed and colours); the set keeps calling it, so the look is unchanged.

new_assets.name: coinPile
new_assets.description: Planned coin mound, with a metal:'silver' palette option (white coins, blue dot shading, black outline) and the planned treasureHoard chest with lid open 0..1.
new_assets.implementation: Use the planned coinPile and treasureHoard chest functions; add a palette argument. Coins are ellipses 22 x 9 stacked in seeded rows; the rolling coin is one ellipse on a kfn path ending in a swing() wobble.

new_assets.name: foodTray
new_assets.description: Planned brass tray with bread, dates and a cup (KD-011); three used on a pale cloth rectangle.
new_assets.implementation: Planned drawing: yellow ellipse 150 x 34 with a rim line, three bread discs, a small heap of brown date ovals.

new_assets.name: weekDots
new_assets.description: Seven small discs in a row, n of them lit with a star, for once or twice a week, days passing, or a count of meetings.
new_assets.implementation: Loop of seven circles (paper fill, black lw 4); lit ones in yellow with a 5-point star and a settleTo pop at their cue time.

new_assets.name: templeTap
new_assets.description: Person hand to the temple with a single tap (mind, thinking, clever). Used by the caliph in S6 and the stranger in S13 and S16. Candidate entry PERSON_HANDS.temple.
new_assets.implementation: A hand target near local [30, -205] at s 1 (measure against the head so the hand touches the side of the turban band and does not read as a salute; if it does, use arm angles); tap = 6-unit out and back in 4 frames.

owner_questions: The script names wine: the plan shows a plain goblet of red wine and two scholars sipping briefly, with nobody shown drunk in the real hall. Default: show it this way.
In the thought cloud at 139.6 to 143.9 the scholar imagines himself tipsy (turban slipped, swaying, sliding back to the door). Default: keep it, mild and comic, only inside the cloud.
The three questions are not given in the script, so they are shown as wordless picture balloons (a knot untied, three pieces joined, a balloon that grows wide). Default: no invented question text.
Added business not in the script: the proud scholar hands the stranger a cushion at 82.7 and all three bow at the end. Default: keep, it pays off those who ignored him.

Invented lettering: A STRANGER, FAR AWAY, CLOSER!, CLOSER STILL!, ALL EYES ON HIM, BESIDE THE CALIPH, GUEST OF HONOUR, CLEAR!, HMM..., NO! NO!, WOW!, WHY?, HA HA!, 100,000. Default: keep these 14 plus the title and THE END.
The scholars are three invented types (proud, old, young) standing in for the whole assembly. Default: three, to keep faces readable on a phone.
Al-Maamun is drawn with a dark beard (age 0.35) rather than the grey caliph preset, and he comes down to a floor cushion for the meal. Default: both as planned.
implementation_notes: One set for the whole film: palaceHall {variant:'palace', wall:'blue', dais:[640, 960, 860], throne:840, cushions:[705]}; bake it; get anchors from palaceHallAnchors with the same options. From 97.2 (hidden under the LATER card) switch to u 0.45 and the floor arrangement.

Seat positions are the story. Keep constants SEAT = {A:[120, 900], B:[262, 900], C:[598, 925], D:[705, 860]} and one function strangerX(t) built with kfn so that walk() and footfalls() drive legs and steps on all four walks (14.2, 59.3, 78.7, 159.2).

All people are person() with costume presets; set LIFE.t = t for auto-blinks and give every character a gaze every frame with look()/lookAt. Suppress blinks with noBlink during the cup suspense (113.5 to 115) and the proud scholars freeze (122.8 to 124).
The figure is front-facing only: sell who is addressed with gaze, a 3 to 6 unit head shift and tip toward the listener; the dais two-shot uses twoShot(caliph, stranger, {margin: 60}).
Raised hand (43.62 and 69.24) must read at zoom 1.2 from the far end of the hall: use arm angles aR about [2.3, 2.6], not a hand target near the head. Reuse the identical pose both times.
Lettering never covers a face: balloons and labels live in the top band (y 280..560 world) except floor arrows. Minimum 44 px headlines, 28 px labels at 1280x720 scale. No dashes.
Draw order from S10: hall, throne, people behind the cloth, cloth and trays, goblet, foreground items. In S16 the foreground goblet at (700, 930) is drawn last at 1.3 scale.
Counted beats: three reasons at 52.98, 53.96, 54.90; two pats at 92.3 and 92.9; two claps at 155.0 and 155.35 (the claps are visual only, no sound: they fall inside words).

Sound: seven quiet effects only, all in the listed pauses or after the last word (3.8 chime, 22.0 soft thud, 43.1 pop, 84.95 chime, 126.8 pop, 147.6 chime, 170.2 chime). SND master 0.6. Nothing else; there is no room between words in this narration.
Subtitles: use the chunk marks in the subtitles array (4 chunks per paragraph, both languages); time each chunk from the first word of its Arabic chunk in timing.json.
Panel-only shake is not needed anywhere; keep the camera eased with holds (keys in pairs).
warnings: Five seated figures plus a servant in a 1000-wide hall is tight: scholars at s 0.64 to 0.66 are about 105 px tall on screen in the wide shots, below the comfortable size, so every acting beat that matters is given a medium or close shot. Check a contact sheet at phone size.

The person figure has no profile; the offer of the cup depends on world hand targets (handRW) meeting exactly at (545, 770). Arms are short (about 74 units at s 1): seat the two men no more than 120 units apart or the cup will not reach.
Wine is shown on screen because the narration names it (owner question 1).
Seat C at y 925 puts the stranger in front of the cushion row; verify he does not hide the proud scholars face at x 511 (move C to x 610 if needed, dais starts at 640).
The LATER card runs over the words at 96.14 to 98.3; it is visual only. The narration has no pause there, so the card gets no sound.

The English translation is a condensed paraphrase of the Arabic (for example P1 omits the hard questions, P7 omits the address O Commander of the Faithful and ends as a question). Both are kept verbatim.
